map.理论产量怎么定？: How is the theoretical yield determined?
map.由配平方程式的限制反应物决定；先找最小摩尔比的反应物，再按系数比算产物上限。: It is set by the limiting reactant in the balanced equation; first find the reactant with the smallest mole ratio, then compute the product upper limit by the coefficient ratio.
map.产率低一定是反应问题吗？: Is a low yield always a reaction problem?
map.不一定。分离、萃取、干燥与转移损失也会拉低；应分步收率定位，而非只看总产率。: Not necessarily. Separation, extraction, drying and transfer losses also lower it; locate the loss step by step rather than looking only at the total yield.
map.多步反应总收率怎么算？: How is the total yield of a multi-step reaction computed?
map.各步收率相乘（如三步 90%×85%×80%≈61%）；提升任一步对总收率都敏感: Multiply the yield of each step (e.g. three steps 90% x 85% x 80% is about 61%); improving any one step has a strong effect on the total yield.
